lounge-androidtv.notes: Android TV web wrapper running a build with the agent. Pair once with `adb pair`, then run adb_setup.

lab-firetv-devtools.notes: USB Fire TV whose wrapper enables WebView debugging: driven over adb-forwarded DevTools, any build.

samsung-tizen.notes: Packaged Tizen app. launch_app restarts it with `sdb shell 0 debug` and forwards the Web Inspector.

lg-webos.notes: webOS app installed in debug mode (ares-inspect exposes the inspector on the TV).

operator-stb.notes: Set-top box with a vendor launch CLI and no adb; slow, so doubled timeouts and pulsed scrub holds.

games-console.notes: Console browser or web app shell reached through its own launcher; agent only, launched by hand.
